rules.statement: Specific performance can be enforced against a party who has breached an agreement to sell land, unless the agreement provides for an alternative remedy such as payment of damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "Can the intending buyer compel the intending seller specifically to perform an agreement to sell a particular land if that agree�ment contains an express stipulation to pay damages generally, or a. certain sum by way of damages in the event of the seller not conveying the land in terms of the agreement. The answer to this question seems to me to depend on the wording of the agreement: and the intention of the parties as indicated by their contract."
